changes.title: Apple and Epic argue over how much Apple should get from purchases made outside the App Store
changes.summary: In a new filing in its long-running legal dispute with Epic Games, Apple has proposed a structure that would allow it to collect fees on digital purchases made via external links that don't use the company's in-app purchase system.
